meaning: the finishing touch that brings a thing to life

story.zh: 以前有一个画家，他在墙上画了四个龙，都没有眼睛。别人问他为什么。他说：“画了眼睛，龙就会飞走。”别人不信。他给两个龙画了眼睛，这两个龙真的飞走了！
story.en: A painter drew four dragons on a temple wall, all without eyes. 'If I dot the eyes, they will fly away,' he said. Nobody believed him — so he dotted the eyes of two, and those two flew off into the sky.
